messages.subject: Referencing Code Blocks
parts:
Hello :-)

I was wondering about numbering and referencing blocks of R code in blocks of text an .Rnw file. 
For instance, I might have a block of code

<<mycodeblock>>=
x <- 1
y <- x+1
@
And would want to refer to code block number [mycodeblock] inside the text like this.

Does anyone know how to do this??

Thanks!

Clark
